reasoning_steps: Factor both expressions and correctly identify their LCM as xy(x+y).
Treat finding the LCM alone as the requested task, omitting multiplication by the HCF.
Report xy(x+y).
Set up the correct product x(x+y) × xy(x+y).
Mistakenly combine x × x as x rather than x^2.
Retain the remaining factors and report xy(x+y)^2.
Correctly identify the LCM as xy(x+y) and the HCF as x(x+y).
Misread গুণফল, meaning product, as a request for the sum.
Add the expressions to obtain x(x+y)(y+1).
Use p+q = 5.
Incorrectly assume p^2+q^2 = (p+q)^2, omitting the 2pq cross term.
Report 5^2 = 25.
Correctly find p = 4 and q = 1.
Make an addition error and report 19 instead of 17.
Square the two given values to obtain (p+q)^2 = 25 and (p−q)^2 = 9.
Report their sum 25+9 = 34 as the requested quantity.
Fail to account for the fact that this sum equals twice p^2+q^2.
Mistakenly assume the two logarithm terms must have equal arguments in order for the equation to hold.
Set a/b = b/a and hence a^2 = b^2.
On the positive domain, report a = b instead of evaluating the sum of the logarithms.
Attempt to combine the two logarithms by multiplying their arguments.
Drop both denominators and calculate (a/b)(b/a) as ab rather than 1.
Equate log(ab) with log(a+b) and report ab = a+b.
Correctly notice that the product (a/b)(b/a) equals 1.
Misinterpret this as a requirement that each individual ratio must equal 1.
Set a/b = 1 and report a = b.
Equate x+7 and x+2 directly without first reconciling the different bases 2 and 4.
Cancel x and obtain the false equality 7 = 2.
Conclude incorrectly that there is no solution.
Correctly convert the right-hand side to 2^(2x+4).
Correctly obtain x = 7−4.
Make a subtraction error and report x = 4.
Misread the exponent x+7 as x+6.
Solve the altered equation x+6 = 2x+4.
Report x = 2, which solves the misread question rather than the original.
Incorrectly simplify (−1)/(1/√3) as −3 rather than −√3.
Use that incorrect common ratio in a5 = a1 × r^4.
Correctly obtain a5 = (1/√3) × 9 = 9/√3.
Drop the denominator when reporting the numerical expression.
Choose 9 instead of simplifying 9/√3 to 3√3.
Correctly calculate the common ratio as −√3.
Misread the request for the fifth term as a request for the common ratio.
Select −√3.
Use the absolute factors 2 and 7 of 14 but ignore the signs required by the coefficients.
Incorrectly factor the polynomial as (x−7)(x−2).
Report the two positive values {2, 7} without checking that the factors expand to the original polynomial.
Correctly obtain the root formula x = (5 ± 9)/2.
Calculate the positive root (5+9)/2 = 14/2 incorrectly as 6.
Reject the correctly computed negative root −2 and report A = {6}.
Correctly find the two roots −2 and 7.
Misread the restriction x ∈ N as allowing all integers.
Keep the negative root and select {−2, 7}.
